children: Upbit has placed Injective (INJ) under an investment warning designation across its KRW, BTC, and USDT markets, and has temporarily suspended INJ deposits and withdrawals on the exchange.

The designation cuts off one of the largest Korean liquidity channels for INJ, since trading continues only for existing balances while deposit and withdrawal support is halted. Holders who want to reduce exposure face thinning exit capacity, and repositioning pressure can push the price away from levels on other venues.

Investment warning designations on Upbit are a supervisory signal that can precede further measures if the underlying concern is not resolved, so the deposit and withdrawal suspension may be extended beyond the initial window. The immediate effect is reduced accessibility and wider price dispersion between Upbit and offshore markets until the designation is lifted or escalated.
